Autocrats Welcome Lame-Duck Trump in Shenzhen

content_html:
Trilateral Summit Hosted in Shenzhen, China

Rebuked by voters following a midterm election defeat that reduced his domestic status, US President Donald Trump traveled to Shenzhen, China, to participate in the first-ever trilateral summit alongside Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin. Convening at the Kylin Villa, the leaders of the world's three biggest nuclear powers engaged in a 70-minute closed-door meeting that produced a four-point document titled the 'Declaration Toward Peace.'

Upon arriving for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit, Trump received a grand reception as Xi personally greeted him on the tarmac with an honor guard and a warm embrace. Throughout the meetings, Trump referred to both leaders as his friends, rating the overall summit experience as 12 out of 10 while facing harsh criticism back home regarding the optics of the gathering.

Core Details of the Shenzhen Meeting

  • The official output of the 70-minute closed-door meeting was a four-point document titled the 'Declaration Toward Peace.'
  • The summit document made no mention of ongoing wars in Iran or Ukraine.
  • The gathering marked the first-ever trilateral summit between the leaders of the US, China, and Russia.

Domestic Backlash and Global Optics

The summit's visual elements, featuring the trio seated around a large circular wooden table centered with an arrangement of pink flowers, drew severe condemnation from US-based critics. Steve Schmidt, a former adviser to President George W Bush and Senator John McCain, described the imagery as a deep sign of shame and weakness that directly repudiates American values, national security interests, and global alliances.

While critics viewed the summit as a new low for American moral authority, Beijing capitalized on the opportunity to satisfy Trump's ego through elaborate welcoming ceremonies. Despite his diminished domestic standing as a lame-duck leader following congressional setbacks, Trump embraced the comfort and flattery offered by his foreign counterparts on the global stage.
